chunks.en_text: “A sage, monks, was Dīghāvu the lay-disciple.

parts.text: “A sage, monks, was Dīghāvu the lay-disciple.

chunks.en_text: He lived according to the Norm.

parts.text: He lived according to the Norm.

chunks.en_text: He did not harm me by disputings about the Norm.

parts.text: He did not harm me by disputings about the Norm.

chunks.en_text: Dīghāvu, the lay-disciple, monks, by wearing out the five fetters of the lower sort, is reborn by spontaneous birth.

parts.text: Dīghāvu, the lay-disciple, monks, by wearing out the five fetters of the lower sort, is reborn by spontaneous birth.

chunks.en_text: His destiny is not to return from that world.”
